name: Ratling Trick Feature
summary: Ratling Trick Feature Long-Las Sniper Your first Accurate weapon hit each round ignores heavy cover. Underhive Rat When you Hide as a reaction, you may also move 5 ft. Spotter Your mark grants +1d4 to the next three allied attacks instead of two. Black-Market Gremlin Once per session, produce one rare ammunition, forged credential, or compact tool with GM approval.
